name: Batch Ray Sampling
aliases: NeRF Training Loop and Ray Batching
definition: Samples a batch of rays for training, either from precomputed ray buffers or by randomly selecting an image and sampling rays on-the-fly.
summary: Batch Ray Sampling is a NeRF training strategy that generates random ray batches per iteration to avoid memory bottlenecks, differing from image-based methods by sampling subsets across the entire image pool.
